name: FUSE
summary:
FUSE is a revolutionary VR and web app platform that empowers anyone to create and manage immersive and highly interactive training and simulations quickly, easily, and on demand.​
​
The FUSE VR app places users inside 360-degree videos and images and allows them to interact with the videos or images as if they were actually there.​
​
FUSE VR interactions include capturing touch, looks, movement, sound, voice, and other actions making simulations as immersive as possible.​
